children: US industrial REIT's Q3 revenue rose 11.9% yr/yr, driven by industrial property acquisitions
Adjusted FFO for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company acquired Florida industrial property and agreed to buy $34 mln Milwaukee portfolio
Company expects to close $34 mln Milwaukee industrial portfolio acquisition in Q4 2026
Company plans to continue expanding industrial property portfolio using new credit facility
Company says industrial market demand remains strong, supporting high occupancy and rental income
INDUSTRIAL ACQUISITIONS - Co said rental income growth was primarily driven by recent industrial property acquisitions
HIGHER OPERATING COSTS - Operating expenses rose mainly due to increased depreciation and real estate costs from new industrial assets
INCREASED INTEREST EXPENSE - Co attributed higher interest costs to greater mortgage debt and higher average interest rates
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the commercial reits peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for One Liberty Properties Inc is $27.00, about 21.5% above its November 2 closing price of $22.23
The stock recently traded at 37 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 43 three months ago
